newsitem.title: USA: Virginia 909 MW nuke seen down at least a week.
newsitem.headline: Virginia 909 MW nuke seen down at least a week.

text.p: Virginia Power Co's 909 megawatt North Anna nuclear power unit 2 was expected to be shut at least a week after tripping off line Tuesday, a company spokesman said Wednesday.
Although no specific restart time has been set, the Mineral, Va. unit "will be down for at lest a week," said spokesman Jim Norvelle.
The unit tripped off line following a generator problem, the spokesman said.
Although electricity demand was above normal in the company's service area due to cold weather, Virginia Power will be able to meet its supply needs despite the outage, Norvelle said.
The adjoining 911 megawatt North Anna nuclear power unit 1 continued to operate normally at 100 percent of capacity, the spokesman said.
